name: Frostwerk Beispieltechnik
description: Frostwerk Beispieltechnik installiert und wartet Kälte- und Klimaanlagen. Das Unternehmen bietet individuelle technische Lösungen, einen Notdienst, erfahrene Servicemitarbeiter, hochwertige Geräte und kundenorientierte Unterstützung.

expected.brandCore: Describe confirmed refrigeration and air-conditioning services; no invented location, founding date or certifications.
expected.valueProposition: Connect supported installation and maintenance to customer needs; no invented leadership or savings.
expected.mission: Present purpose, only when explicitly supplied; otherwise missing with an optional question.
expected.vision: Future ambition only when supplied; never fabricate a confirmed aspiration.
expected.values: Proposed organizational principles, classified ai_interpretation; never verified values without evidence.
expected.personas: Only evidence-supported buyers/segments; technical services alone do not prove a household or B2B audience.
expected.toneOfVoice: Consistent communication characteristics, not experienced staff or quality equipment.
expected.messagingPillars: Supported customer takeaways, no unsupported superiority or guarantees.
expected.contentGuidelines: Actionable editorial rules, not promotional company statements.
expected.keywords: Relevant search/topic terms, not invented products or certifications.
expected.dosAndDonts: Actionable communication behaviors in the correct positive/negative lists.
expected.brandVoiceExamples: Concrete good/avoid communication examples without adding company facts.
expected.brandAssets: Only supplied visual identity facts; no invented colors or fonts.
